items.context: @Cryptobullmaker (116.549 seguidores) cita su propio hilo sobre MVRV: realized price ~$53.700; picos de MVRV 5,91 (2013), 4,72 (2017), 2,93 (2021), 2,29 (2025) y pisos 0,56/0,69/0,75; extrapola un piso de MVRV ~1,03 ≈ $55.300 y un escenario más profundo en $48–49K (CVDD). Post de minutos con 3186 vistas y 1 respuesta. Ángulo: MVRV y temperatura de mercado.
items.suggested_text:
The compression in MVRV extremes is one of the cleaner long-term patterns in the data: each top and each bottom less extreme than the last as the asset gets bigger and more widely held. The catch is that a ratio trend built on three cycles is three data points, and extrapolating it to a bottom at 1.03 assumes the compression keeps the same slope.

That's why I don't lean on MVRV alone. My Market Temperature index gives it 25%, next to price vs the 200-week average, the drawdown from the ATH and volatility-adjusted 90-day momentum. Over 364 days it went from 99.29 to 0.67: https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122727211610542288

When several of those read cold at once, the zone matters more than the exact number. The part no ratio settles is how long price stays there.
